[[Mikolas]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for [[core]] and [[Factions]] [[profession]]s using the [[Luxon armor#Elite|Elite Luxon armor]] art. Mikolas also crafts [[Elementalist headgear#Auras|Elementalist auras]].

Elite Luxon armor requires the [[rare crafting material]] [[Jadeite]].
